sections.Engineering change: ECN-001 replaces MAT-101 with MAT-102. The effective week is W6 and the use-up end is W5. Finished assemblies affected: KIT-301, PUMP-001, PUMP-002.
sections.Inventory impact: Opening stock is 500 units of Rev B and 0 units of Rev C. Weekly demand is between 80 units and 150 units. Expected: 200 units of Rev B receipts in W3; 100 units of Rev B receipts in W5; 500 units of Rev C receipts in W8. Without corrective action the shortage is 300 units, in W6, W7. Without corrective action the excess value is ₹92,000.
sections.Planner decision: Action owners: Purchasing. Nothing is approved until the planner decides.
sections.Recommendation: PLAN-687e3a317d ranks first of 1680 feasible plans. Actions: Expedite PO-003 by 2 wk; Reduce PO-001 by 200. Its shortage is 0 units, excess value ₹12,000 and action cost ₹17,000, ₹29,000 combined. Plans are ranked by shortage first, then by excess value plus action cost.
sections.Risks: Critical exception EXC-001 in W6: production shortage, impact ₹3,00,000. Critical exception EXC-002 in W7: production shortage, impact ₹3,00,000. High exception EXC-003 in W5: rev b scrap risk, impact ₹92,000. Supplier S3 is blocked. Supplier S4 is unqualified. 6 rejected plans break these rules: po window, purchasing block, purchasing group, rev b use up, supplier qualification.
sections.Robustness: PLAN-687e3a317d has zero shortage in 2/9 stress runs. Stress with lead time +0 wk and demand +10%: shortage 67 units. Stress with lead time +1 wk and demand -10%: shortage 135 units. Stress with lead time +1 wk and unchanged demand: shortage 150 units. Stress with lead time +1 wk and demand +10%: shortage 217 units. Stress with lead time +2 wk and demand -10%: shortage 270 units. Stress with lead time +2 wk and unchanged demand: shortage 300 units. Stress with lead time +2 wk and demand +10%: shortage 382 units. Near-tie: the planner must choose between PLAN-687e3a317d, PLAN-05fb42bb25, PLAN-86af00bfc0, PLAN-f7df897c11, PLAN-e68b49eb73.
